clauses.text: This Agreement is entered into between [CLIENT_NAME] ("Client") and [PROVIDER_NAME] ("Service Provider").
This Agreement governs the provision of landscaping and gardening services by the Service Provider to the Client at [PROPERTY_ADDRESS].
The Service Provider shall perform the services described in [LANDSCAPING_SERVICES_INCLUDED] at [PROPERTY_ADDRESS], such as lawn mowing, edging, pruning, weeding, and fertilizing, as applicable.
The Services shall be provided with a frequency of [SERVICE_FREQUENCY], in accordance with the seasonal schedule described in [SEASONAL_SCHEDULE], starting on [START_DATE].
The Client shall pay the Service Provider [TOTAL_VALUE], payable via [PAYMENT_METHOD] according to the schedule agreed between the Parties.
If the Client fails to pay any amount due by its due date, the Service Provider may charge interest on the overdue amount at [LATE_PAYMENT_RATE] per month.

Unless otherwise agreed, the Service Provider shall supply plants, mulch, and other landscaping materials, with the cost included in [TOTAL_VALUE]. Plants installed by the Service Provider are warranted for [PLANT_WARRANTY_PERIOD], excluding loss caused by inadequate watering by the Client, extreme weather, or pest infestation beyond the Service Provider's control.

Where the Services include irrigation system maintenance, the Service Provider shall inspect and adjust the system as needed and shall promptly notify the Client of any leak, malfunction, or damage observed.
Where the Client is not present during a scheduled visit, the Client shall provide the Service Provider with access to the property via [ACCESS_METHOD].
The Service Provider may reschedule a visit affected by rain, storms, or other adverse weather conditions and shall notify the Client of the revised date.
The Service Provider shall remove and dispose of green waste and debris generated by the Services, unless the Parties agree that the Client will retain clippings for composting.

Additional or seasonal services, such as leaf removal, snow removal, aeration, or tree trimming, may be requested by the Client and shall be charged separately as agreed in writing before performance.
The Service Provider shall maintain general liability insurance covering its work under this Agreement and shall provide proof of coverage upon the Client's reasonable request.
The Client shall identify and mark any underground utilities, irrigation lines, or hazards known to the Client, and shall disclose the location of plants or areas requiring special care.
Neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, or consequential loss arising from this Agreement.
Each Party's total liability arising from this Agreement shall not exceed [TOTAL_VALUE], except for loss arising from gross negligence, willful misconduct, or fraud.

Neither Party shall be liable for a failure to perform its obligations to the extent that failure results from an event beyond that Party's reasonable control that could not have been avoided through reasonable diligence. The affected Party shall notify the other Party without undue delay.
This Agreement shall be governed by [APPLICABLE_LAW]. Any dispute shall be submitted to [DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_MECHANISM] before litigation, except where interim injunctive relief is required.
The Parties have executed this Agreement as of [SIGNATURE_DATE].
